keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «글롭은 무척 배가 고프다(문제)» 와 «이제 김치는 글롭이 우주에서 제일 좋아하는 음식이다(결말)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Glorp is very hungry) and the ending (kimchi is now his favorite food in the universe). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Glorp the alien and a kind grandma

qs.q: Why does Glorp's face turn red?
opts: The ice cream is too cold.
evs: He eats three bowls of rice with kimchi.
why: 글롭이 김치를 먹고 «Hot! Hot!» 하고 말해요. 김치가 매워서 얼굴이 빨개져요.
Glorp says, "Hot! Hot!" The kimchi is spicy, so his face turns red.

qs.q: "Now kimchi is his favorite food in the universe!" What does "favorite" mean?
opts: the one he likes the most
the one he likes the least
evs: An alien named Glorp lands in Seoul.
He eats three bowls of rice with kimchi.
Then a grandma gives him some kimchi.
why: 글롭은 김치와 밥을 세 그릇이나 먹어요. 그만큼 좋아해요. «favorite» 은 가장 좋아하는 것이라는 뜻이에요.
Glorp eats three bowls of rice with kimchi. He likes it so much. "Favorite" means the one he likes the most.

qs.q: Why does Glorp like kimchi more than the hamburger?
qs.qko: 글롭은 왜 햄버거보다 김치를 더 좋아하나요?
opts: The grandma tells him to eat it.
The hamburger is too soft, but kimchi is so good.
evs: An alien named Glorp lands in Seoul.
Then a grandma gives him some kimchi.
why: 햄버거는 «Too soft!» 너무 물렁했어요. 김치는 «But so good!» 정말 맛있어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
The hamburger is "too soft," but kimchi is "so good." You need both sentences.

ends: Glorp takes kimchi home to his planet for his family.
글롭이 가족을 위해 김치를 자기 별로 가져간다.
Glorp learns how to make kimchi with the grandma.
글롭이 할머니와 함께 김치 만드는 법을 배운다.

write.src: “I want to <u>try kimchi</u> because <u>it is hot but so good</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because my friends like it)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because my friends like it)

img.cover: In a cozy Korean kitchen, Glorp, a small round green alien with three eyes on short stalks and a silver suit, has a bright red face and puffs of steam above his head after a bite of kimchi from his chopsticks, while a kind grandma with short white curly hair, a pink apron and round glasses laughs and holds a big bowl of kimchi.

scenes.1: At a small wooden table, Glorp, a small round green alien with three eyes on short stalks and a silver suit, pushes away a hamburger and a melting ice cream cone, as a kind grandma with short white curly hair, a pink apron and round glasses smiles and hands him a bowl of red kimchi.
scenes.2: At the same wooden table, Glorp, a small round green alien with three eyes on short stalks and a silver suit, happily eats rice and kimchi next to three empty rice bowls stacked up, and a kind grandma with short white curly hair, a pink apron and round glasses claps her hands with joy.
